messages:
Sam: FYI canary is showing console main dashboard regressions in eu-west. LCP up ~1.6s. Users report stutter when switching time ranges. link: https://internal.redwood/dash/xyz
Priya: I grabbed a flame. Root cause looks like sync-eval of a new intl/date-format module during app bootstrap. It pulls in a locale-data pack and a tiny-format lib that we also vendor separately -> duplicate parse cost
Tom: i also saw a change in the fetch path for chart-series introduced last week (analytics-proxy). TTFB for /v1/charts/query is +100-140ms for eu canary requests
Anya: are the chart frames waiting for data or doing layout while parse is happening? trace shows both: main thread busy while module eval, then network wait for data, then heavy layout reflow
Keven: so it's compounding: client bootstrap inflation + routing latency. Two levers to attack. Prefer fixing client first if non-invasive
Priya: quick mitigation: defer loading the intl helper until chart render. I can replace the sync utility import with a dynamic import in ChartTimeAxis component. Patch sketch:
```
// before: import {formatDate} from 'intl/date-format';
// after:
let formatDate;
onMount(async ()=>{ formatDate = (await import('intl/date-format')).formatDate });
```
Tom: also could wrap telemetry init with requestIdleCallback so it's out of critical path. That avoids touching chart code while we validate patches
Anya: downside: telemetry needs user context early for some attribution features. But we can gate heavy formatting behind sampling and still init minimal telemetry early (no locales)
Sam: let's do two quick experiments in canary: (A) Priya's chart dynamic import, (B) telemetry deferred init via requestIdleCallback and sampling. Roll whichever works faster
Keven: i'll standby on routing rollback ticket RW-921 if client experiments don't restore SLOs. But prefer not to change routing unless necessary
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for sha:0a1b2c3  watchlist: perf-main-dashboard. status: queued
Priya: pushed a small patch for chart lazy-intl, canary build triggered: https://ci.redwood/9876. Will run synthetic LCP after deploy
Tom: pushed telemetry idle-init prototype behind rollout flag (flag:telemetry.defer). will keep on until we have numbers
Anya: ran a quick local sim: lazy-intl cuts initial parse by ~120ms and reduced main-thread busy time during firstpaint. Not a full fix but helpful
Priya: canary synthetic LCP after patch: baseline 2.1s -> 1.05s. trace: https://trace/internal/after-4987654321. Frameskips dropped significantly
Sam: that's promising. Keep telemetry change gated and hold routing rollback. Also add a CI rule to detect duplicated vendor modules (intl/date-format and tiny-format) so we catch future duplication
Keven: filed RW-issue-943 (routing rollback ready) and RW-issue-944 (ci bundle-dup detection). I'll also add a one-off alert to perf dashboards for sudden vendor size deltas
Tom: note for follow-up: add locale-data splitting (load only en+eu as needed) and make intl helper tree-shake better in webpack config
Anya: I'll update rollout notes and ping product for possible metric noise during the next hour
Sam: owners: Priya (chart patch), Tom (telemetry gating), Keven (routing guard & CI), Anya (release note). Re-evaluate in 30m
Priya: update 18m: numbers stable on canary, will open PR to land lazy-intl and small webpack tweak to avoid duplication
Sam: thanks all. closing thread unless we see further regression. ping in #eng-platform if anything pops
